# Scaler

> > Scaler is an outcome-focused ed-tech platform by InterviewBit that provides tech upskilling programs, coding bootcamps, and career transition support through live events, capstone projects, and placement assistance.

Scaler offers comprehensive tech education through multiple schools including Scaler Academy, School of Technology, and School of Business. The platform combines online learning with live events, webinars, and hands-on projects to help professionals transition into tech careers and advance their skills in software development, DevOps, and related fields.
